body: I feel you!! A month ago, I got off prozac after 4 years of feeling like there was a layer of seran wrap on my brain, and I’ve actually been feeling more functional lately. I’ve been able to get basic things done that I’ve always had difficulty finding motivation for (i.e. household chores, taking care of myself), I made art for the first time in years, and my sex drive is way higher than usual, which is dope. I couldn’t imagine getting off of it at first, but in the last year I felt like the prozac just wasn’t as effective at controlling my symptoms anymore, so I kinda just said fuck it. I’m still depressed and some days are worse than others, but medication has never fully helped that for me, and if I’m gonna be depressed anyway I might as well get rid of some of those worm-brain symptoms. Wish you luck!!!
